evidence.computation: Home-energy catalogue: device energy and running cost, passive device-swap savings, nominal or efficiency/depth-adjusted battery runtime, solar yield, and simple payback. Reply kind selects the operation; this static declaration is not a per-answer interpretation proof.
assumptions: Runtime uses constant load, nominal capacity, positive voltage/load and nonnegative Wh/kWh or amp-hours. For adjusted runtime only, efficiency and usable depth are in [0,1]; zero factors give zero runtime. Unmentioned factors are one; mentioned unread factors and round-trip descriptions need clarification.
Device costs require a stated tariff; simple payback ignores financing and future price changes. Solar yield uses stated peak sun hours and derating.
No dynamic battery discharge, ageing, voltage sag or self-discharge model.
untrusted: English operation recognition, decimal and unit parsing, JSON framing. The family declaration does not establish that the recognized request matches the question.
